G-quail-drive-0010.recDirections: Frog Falls can be reached using the Wap Creek forest service road, which starts at the Trans-Canada Highway just west of Three Valley Gap. While road conditions vary with weather, two-wheel drive vehicles can usually use this road in summer. Frog Falls is located 4.3 km on the Wap Lake Forest Service Road on the left side of the road. Caution - This is an active industrial road - using a two-way radio with resource road channels is recommended.
